name: Depth Anything V2 Small · Apple Core ML FP16

input.name: image
input.preprocessing: Embedded normalization; PhotoP aspect-fit with edge padding into 518x392, crop output to fitted ROI; no extra ImageNet normalization. Differs from publisher stretch benchmark and needs device validation.

rights_basis: Upstream README licenses Small under Apache-2.0; Apple model card license apache-2.0; exact package metadata says Apache 2. Not a separate legal opinion.
selection: Initial bundled offline depth model. FP16 chosen over quantized variants to avoid unmeasured edge-quality loss. No Base/Large/Giant weights.
runtime_validation: Core ML prediction requires macOS/iOS and has not been executed in Linux. Upstream phone timing is not PhotoP timing.
